text: A woman, likely late teens to early twenties, stands barefoot in a ruined alley. She has long, flowing red hair, an oval face with defined cheekbones, and striking orange eyes. Her skin is pale. She wears a sheer, light-blue gown with a deep V-neck and high slit, cinched at the waist by a dark belt. Accessories include a choker, bracelets, and dangling earrings. One hand rests on her thigh; the other near her hip. She gazes upward, illuminated by distant blue light.
